name: Polygon-based Volumetric Rendering with Depth Peeling
definition: A technique to render solid 3D bodies from volumetric data by constructing a mesh of polygons (slices) and applying a 3D texture, using an undocumented rendering option to handle transparency sorting.
summary: Polygon-based Volumetric Rendering with Depth Peeling visualizes scalar fields by piling semi-transparent polygon slices draped with 3D textures, differing from other methods by explicitly constructing geometric meshes rather than relying on hardware texture slicing.
